constraints.definition: CHECK ((((epoch = 1) AND (parent_epoch IS NULL) AND (parent_snapshot_id IS NULL) AND (parent_manifest_hash IS NULL) AND (parent_registry_snapshot_hash IS NULL)) OR ((epoch > 1) AND (parent_epoch = (epoch - 1)) AND (parent_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL) AND (parent_manifest_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (parent_registry_snapshot_hash IS NOT NULL))))
constraints.name: ck_split_snapshots_parent_chain

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((m5_status = 'MATCH'::text) AND (NOT integrity_degraded)) OR ((m5_status = 'ABSENT'::text) AND integrity_degraded)))
constraints.name: ck_bam_profiles_degraded_iff_absent
